content: En Depit Powehdi kan nan Mahwen
Mwurin ahnsou ehu Nanmwarki Depit ahpw pwurehng mahweniong mehn Pilisdia kan oh kaloweiraildi. E ketikihsang arail manaman pohn kahnimw Kad iangahki kousapw akan me kapilpene.
E pil kalowehdi mehn Mohap kan, me wiahla sapwellime aramas oh kin pwainohng arail daksis.
Mwuhr, Depit mahweniong Adadeser mehn Siria, nanmwarkien Sopa, limwahn sapwen Amad, pwehki Adadeser eh songosong en pwurehng sapwellimanikihla manaman nan sahpw me mi palipohn Pillap Eupreitis.
Depit kalowehdi tehnwere werennansapw kid, soundak oahs isikid, oh sounpei alu rianen. E ketikihsang uwen oahs me itarohng werennansapw epwiki, e ahpw ketin katimpeseng nehn oahs me luhwe ko.
Ni ahnsou me mehn Siria en Damaskus kadarala karis ehu pwehn sewese Nanmwarki Adadeser, Depit ahpw mahweniong kariso oh kemehla aramas rianen riekid.
Ih eri kauwada wasahn kousoan en sounpei kei nan sapwarailo, irail eri wiahla sapwellime aramas oh kin pwainohng daksis. KAUN-O ketin kupwurehda pwe Depit en kin powehdi wasa koaros.
Depit ketikihsang mehn sansar kohl me sapwellimen Adadeser lapalap akan kin weuwa oh ketikilahng Serusalem.

E pil ketikihsang uwe ieu en prons sang Tipad oh Kun, kahnimw kan me Adadeser kaunda. (Mwuhr, Solomon ketin doadoahngki prons wet ong ni dengk, uhr ko, oh dipwisou prons kan me kin doadoahk nan Tehnpas Sarawio.)
Toi, nanmwarkien Amad, karongehda me Depit kalowedier sapwellimen Adadeser kariso pwon.

Ih eri kadarala sapwellime pwutak Soram pwe en rahnmwahwih Nanmwarki Depit oh kapaiamwahwih pwehki eh ketin kalowehdi Adadeser, me Toi kin ketin mahweniong pak tohto. Soram patohwandohng Depit kisakis kei me wiawihkihda kohl, silper, oh prons.
Nanmwarki Depit eri ketin kasarawihong dipwisou ko ni doadoahk en kaudok, iangahki silper oh kohl me e ketikihsang wehi kan me e kalowehdi—Edom, Mohap, Ammon, Pilisdia, oh Amelek.
Apisai, me eh nohno Seruaia, kalowehdi mehn Edom kan nan Wahun Soahl oh kemehla me nen welikid.
E ahpw kauwada kahnimpwal en sounpei kei wasa koaros nan Edom, oh tohn wasao ahpw wiahla sapwellimen Depit. KAUN-O ketin kupwurehda pwe Depit en kalowehdi wasa koaros.
Depit ketin kakaun Israel pwon oh ketin tetehk mwahu sapwellime aramas pwe epwelparail en pahrek oh pwung ahnsou koaros.
Rien Apisai pwutak, Sohap, me kaunda kariso; Seosopat nein Ahilud me kin apwalih palien pwuhken poadopoad kan;
Sadok nein Ahidup oh Ahimelek nein Apaiadar iei ira me samworo; Seraia me sounnting en tehnpaso;
Penaia nein Sehoiada me kin apwalih sapwellimen Depit sounsilasil kan; oh sapwellimen Depit pwutak kan ahneki pwukoa kesempwal en papah nanmwarkio.
